info.name: S-Hub Chat API
info.description:
Real-time chat API for S-Hub. All requests require Bearer token from login.

Base URL: http://192.168.101.117:8000/api/v1

request.description:
Returns the list of users the authenticated user is allowed to chat with.

- Parent → child's teachers + principal
- Teacher → all teachers + principal + parents of their students
- Principal / School Admin → all teachers + all parents

response.name: 200 OK — Teacher contacts

request.description: Creates a new conversation with the given user, or returns the existing one if it already exists. Safe to call multiple times — idempotent.

response.name: 200 OK — Conversation found or created

request.description: Returns all conversations for the authenticated user, sorted by most recent message. Includes last message preview and unread count per conversation.

response.name: 200 OK — Inbox

request.description: Opens a conversation and returns paginated messages (20 per page, newest first). Also automatically marks all unread messages from the other person as read.

response.name: 200 OK — Messages

request.description: Sends a text message. After saving to DB, fires a Reverb broadcast event to the private channel `chat.{conv_id}` so the recipient receives it in real-time.

response.name: 201 Created — Message sent
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Message sent successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": 13,
    "conversation_id": 3,
    "body": "Hello! When is the next parent-teacher meeting?",
    "attachment": null,
    "attachment_type": null,
    "is_mine": true,
    "read_at": null,
    "sender": { "id": 3, "full_name": "Ahmed Ali", "profile_picture": "..." },
    "created_at": "2026-05-19T10:47:00.000000Z"
  }
}

request.description: Send a message with a file or image attachment (up to 20MB). Use multipart/form-data. Supported: jpg, png, gif, webp, pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx. The `body` field is optional — you can send a file without any text.

response.name: 201 Created — Message with attachment
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Message sent successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": 14,
    "conversation_id": 3,
    "body": "Please check this file",
    "attachment": "http://192.168.101.117:8000/storage/chat/attachments/file.pdf",
    "attachment_type": "file",
    "is_mine": true,
    "read_at": null,
    "sender": { "id": 3, "full_name": "Ahmed Ali", "profile_picture": "..." },
    "created_at": "2026-05-19T10:48:00.000000Z"
  }
}

request.description: Marks all unread messages from the OTHER participant in this conversation as read (sets read_at = now). Call this when the user opens a conversation.
